registered_before: any Stage A decomposition, stage attribution, recoverability classification or oracle computation on sealed V5/V6 artifacts
registration_context: No Stage A computation has been executed anywhere in this environment at registration time. Sealed V5/V6 artifacts are not yet present here; gates are frozen before their arrival.

stage_a_stop_gates.rule: STOP / hybrid not justified if ANY of the following holds after Stage A on sealed V6
stage_a_stop_gates.on_stop: REJECT_EARLY: do not build C-ALR, do not build V7, Arm C remains integration baseline

stage_a_rules.attribution_source: sealed B4 stage logs only; if logs absent -> UNATTRIBUTED_NO_LOGS
stage_a_rules.classification_of_recoverability: deterministic typed-field diff phi_C vs gold restricted to the frozen mutation catalog; catalog-coverage rule: ALL differences mappable to catalog mutation types AND at most 2 mutations per case -> LOCAL_PATCH_RECOVERABLE, otherwise REQUIRES_GLOBAL_REPARSE; missing field-level representations -> UNCERTAIN; missing gold -> NOT_RECOVERABLE

v7_primary_gates.underpowered_fallback_registered_now: two-sided 95% paired CI for H2-C excludes 0 AND its lower bound >= +1.5 pp; this fallback is fixed now and may not be changed after V7 results
v7_primary_gates.note: raw percentage delta alone is never sufficient proof

v7_safety_gates.hard_requirement: net recoveries must significantly exceed regressions; improvement bought by destroying simple C-correct cases (e.g. +10 hard corrections vs -8 simple regressions) is NOT a KEEP even with positive aggregate delta

v7_efficiency_gates.note: exact budget values are frozen defaults registered before any V7 inference; user may amend only BEFORE the first V7 external call, never after

mutation_catalog_frozen_v1.note: mutation is a hypothesis to test, never automatically a supported interpretation; admission requires positive exact-span textual evidence
